rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic devices to set rents
rules.quote: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
rules.summary: Landlords cannot sell or use algorithmic devices that analyze nonpublic competitor rental data to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Legislation adding Section 37.10C to the Rent Ordinance went into effect on October 14, 2024.
rules.penalty: allows a tenant or the City Attorney to bring a civil action
